status: Implementation ready for parent integration. No Blender process, model build, export or rendered acceptance performed.

implementation.api: enhance_pixel_front_optics(profile); explicit call is opt-in, importing module has no Blender or scene side effects
implementation.geometry: One replacement mesh per known circular aperture object, with three closed components: black well/annular rim, deeper opaque lens, one transmissive coated cover. Four shared front-only materials. Generated disks retain transforms; imported Pixel 10 Pro front disk is explicitly fitted to its measured screen/cutout spec and its separate obsolete front coating object removed. No spheres, new scene objects, screen mesh/UV edits or rear changes.
implementation.bounds: Radius is taken from runtime screen cutouts (original Fold bezel retains its existing bezel feature radius); depth is measured from the existing disk. All local vertices lie within +/-depth/2 and within radius. Generated aperture centers/parents/transforms/names stay intact. Imported 10 Pro front disk center alone is fitted to the runtime screen spec/cutout; parent and name remain intact.
implementation.depth_limit: DEPTH IS COMPRESSED AND ILLUSTRATIVE, NOT A PHYSICAL CAMERA WELL. The source screen commonly remains continuous underneath. Existing aperture disk centers are 0.025 mm in front of OLED, thickness 0.025 mm; all new geometry remains 0.0125-0.0375 mm in front of the OLED. No real recess into glass/body or deep optical prescription is claimed.
implementation.normal_winding: Each component has positive signed volume for front_sign +1 and -1. Negative direction mirrors local Z and reverses every face, so top cap normals face the outward camera direction. 64 radial segments; no repeated ring-center vertices or degenerate center quads.
implementation.materials: well .52 roughness; narrow graphite annulus .12 metallic/.32 roughness; dark violet deeper lens .17 roughness; cover .85 transmission, IOR 1.46, .10 roughness, .25 coat. Color/roughness/IOR are appearance estimates, not measured manufacturer samples.
gltf_expectations: Principled material should export KHR_materials_transmission transmissionFactor=0.85, KHR_materials_ior ior=1.46, and KHR_materials_clearcoat clearcoatFactor=0.25 on Pixel front optics | coated glass, subject to parent exporter validation.

The other three materials are opaque. Exactly one transmissive component avoids stacking multiple screen-space transmission layers. OPAQUE alphaMode is valid for glTF transmission; no alpha blending is requested.
No Thin Film inputs or KHR_materials_iridescence are claimed. Violet appearance comes from an estimated dark deeper element through a neutral cover, not a measured interference coating.
Names do not match build.py coating_for / LENS_COATINGS substrings; existing rear optical post-processing must leave these four materials unchanged. No common rear helper edits required.

Parent must inspect exported extensions, front-facing normals, grazing-angle reflections, tiny depth separation and visibility in the actual viewer. Geometry-only checks cannot validate transmission or lighting.
implementation.visibility_contract: Old aperture mesh is replaced, never left as an opaque disk in front of a hidden stack. Well floor z=screen+.018mm, deeper-lens top z=screen+.0225mm and cover z=screen+.0265mm for the .025mm source disk centered at screen+.025mm; all lie in front of the continuous OLED. For imported 10 Pro, the old Selfie lens coating object is removed after replacement. No native UVs or curved screen Z values change.

if profile['id'].startswith('pixel-') and profile.get('pixel_front_optics', False):
